prompt: The whole artwork page: the real work on a stage tinted by its own colours, with alternate views and a zoom lightbox, beside a printed museum wall label (the page h1) and the museum's description.
shortDesc: The whole /artwork/<id> page body from ONE prop, artwork-id="aic-16568" or "met-436535" (the id from the URL, as-is). It fetches everything itself and renders the page h1 (the artwork title), so don't add a level="1" section or pass any image. It shows the large uncropped real image on a full-width stage tinted by the work, alternate views, a zoom lightbox (wheel, pinch, drag, keyboard) and a Download link for public-domain works, beside the museum wall label: italic title, the artist linked to /artist/<name> with nationality and dates, date, medium, dimensions, place, classification, style, a collection link, credit line, 'On view · Gallery n' and 'Public domain' badges, an 'Add to exhibition' button, the museum's description with 'Read more', and a link to the museum's page. Put it first in <main>, then <g-page-section heading="More by this artist"><g-artwork-grid more-by-artist-of="<same id>" layout="rail"></g-artwork-grid></g-page-section> (one shared request; that section hides itself when there are no other works). Bad or unknown ids show their own error with Try again and search links.

props.name: artwork-id
props.description: Artwork id from the URL, e.g. aic-16568 or met-436535 (aic-<number> or met-<number>). Anything else shows the error state without fetching.

styling.tailwindClasses: block; stage: grid h-[clamp(360px,72vh,800px)]; below: max-w-[1240px] mx-auto px-4 py-7 md:px-8 md:py-12 grid md:grid-cols-[7fr_5fr] gap-14; label: bg-[#fffdf9] border border-[#e0d9cd] rounded-sm p-7 sticky top-6 max-h-[calc(100vh-48px)] overflow-auto (sticky only on wide screens; scrolls within itself when taller than the viewport)
styling.notes: VITRINE kit. Stage on var(--art-tint, --night): the loaded image is averaged in a 12x12 canvas, saturation clamped to 0.25, lightness 14%. Image uncropped (object-fit: contain) with a drop shadow, eager + fetchpriority high (it is the LCP), and a '⤢ Zoom' chip; a bottom bar holds 56px mat thumbnails (aria-pressed, arrow keys) and a night-ink 13px Download link. Wall label: gilt 32px hairline, museum as .label, Newsreader italic h1 clamp(30px,3.4vw,40px) weight 500, oxblood artist link, soft artistBio, serif tabular date, g-add-to-exhibition, hairline, a 110px dt/.label + 14px dd grid, gilt-ink chips. Description in Newsreader 18px/1.65 at 65ch, folded after ~700 characters. Zoom is a native <dialog> on --night with − / 100% / + / Fit / Close at 44px; the medium image shows first with a 'Loading full resolution…' pill. Only same-origin /__art/ URLs are ever used as image sources; failures show the neutral mat placeholder. Reduced motion turns off fades, tint and zoom transitions.

dependencies.usage: Rendered in the wall label as <g-add-to-exhibition artwork-id="{artwork-id}">.

interactions.trigger: component mounts or artwork-id changes (skipped when the id isn't aic-<n>/met-<n>)
interactions.bodyShape: READS.artwork(id) from the kit's shared DATA block, byte-identical to g-artwork-grid more-by-artist-of, g-feature-hero artwork-id and g-exhibition-form artwork-id: { intent: 'get artwork details (GetArtwork)', id, outputFormat: { id, title, artist, artistBio, date, museum, imageUrl, largeImageUrl, imageAlt, additionalImages[{imageUrl, thumbUrl}], medium, dimensions, creditLine, department, departmentId, placeOfOrigin, style, classification, description, onView, gallery, isPublicDomain, sourceUrl, moreByArtist[CARD] } }
